🚨 Emergency

110Police119Ambulance / Fire

Singapore Embassy, Tokyo: +81 3 3586 9111 (office hours) · after hours +81 90 5258 3252
MFA Duty Office (24h): +65 6379 8800 / 8855

On 119 the operator asks “Kaji ka, kyūkyū ka?” (fire or ambulance?). Answer “Kyūkyū” for an ambulance. Check the embassy numbers at tokyo.mfa.gov.sg before you travel.
